definitions.explanation: A container, typically made of ceramic, plastic, or terracotta, used for growing plants.

examples.japanese: {植木鉢|うえきばち}に{花|はな}を{植|う}えた。
examples.english: I planted flowers in a flower pot.

examples.japanese: {植木鉢|うえきばち}を{大|おお}きいものに{替|か}える。
examples.english: I'll change to a bigger pot.

examples.japanese: ベランダに{植木鉢|うえきばち}を{並|なら}べている。
examples.english: I have flower pots lined up on the balcony.

notes:
{植木鉢|うえきばち} is a pot for growing plants.

MATERIALS:
- {素焼|すや}き (unglazed terracotta)
- {陶器|とうき} (ceramic)
- プラスチック (plastic)
- {木製|もくせい} (wooden)

SIZE SYSTEM:
- Pot sizes in Japan are measured in {号|ごう} (approximately 3cm per unit)
- {3号鉢|さんごうばち}: ~9cm diameter
- {5号鉢|ごごうばち}: ~15cm diameter
- {7号鉢|ななごうばち}: ~21cm diameter

RELATED ITEMS:
- {鉢皿|はちざら} (saucer for catching water)
- {鉢底石|はちぞこいし} (drainage stones)
- {培養土|ばいようど} (potting soil)

RELATED TERMS:
- {鉢|はち} (pot - general term)
- プランター (planter box)
